festivals.what: Yamaguchi Gion Festival (Yasaka Shrine, Yamaguchi City): 20 to 27 July (2026 listing); the procession with the heron dance (sagi no mai) on the 20th, a citizens' dance on the 24th and the return of the deity on the 27th.

laws.rule: Shimonoseki City bans smoking on the street in two districts: around Takezaki-cho (the Shimonoseki Station area) and around Karato-cho (the Karato waterfront). Since 1 February 2020 the ban covers heated tobacco too. Smoking there outside a designated smoking spot brings a JPY 1,000 penalty (about A$9.02, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). After a spot closed on 15 June 2022, one designated smoking spot remains, in the Takezaki-cho district.

laws.rule: Iwakuni City bans smoking on the street in three zones: around Iwakuni Station (parts of Marifu-cho), the Kintai Bridge area, and the city hall area (including the adjacent sidewalks and a park). Littering is banned citywide with an administrative fine of JPY 1,000 (about A$9.02, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); the city page says breaches of the street-smoking ban in the zones are also penalised, but the extract read does not state the smoking amount separately. In force since 1 July 2010.
